text:
You want to grow Pinterest traffic to your Etsy items and blog posts, and I can help turn that account into a stronger traffic source.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, and data visualization with SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. While I’m not a Pinterest marketer by title, I’m strong at tracking what drives traffic and making it visible so you can focus on what works.

For Verdant Skincare, I built a marketing attribution analysis by joining ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery and comparing first-click, last-click, and position-based credit in Looker Studio. That helped reallocate 18% of the ad budget and brought CAC down 12% the next quarter.

If you want, I can help you measure which pins, posts, and products are actually driving visitors.
